title: Distinguishing waivers from refunds
passage:
If we tell the parents the bus fee was waived, will they think we’re refunding the money they already paid?
A. They paid the bus fee and the admission fee on the same form.
B. It could sound that way. The waiver is only for families that haven’t paid yet. We haven’t decided on refunds.
C. The office used to accept cash for the bus.
passageZh:
如果跟家長說接駁車費用已免收，他們會不會以為我們會退還已經付的錢？
A. 他們在同一張表單繳付接駁費和入場費。
B. 有可能會讓人這樣理解。免收只適用尚未繳費的家庭，退款還沒決定。
C. 辦公室以前收過現金車費。
